baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated imperatives at focus words 5-7 and the comparative at word 9.
baseline_models.mechanism: Humbled obedience is paired with putting oneself behind a guard; the deictic gathers both acts into one beneficial arrangement for the addressees.

activation_trace.role: Supplies obedient worship with submission as the allegiance pole of the paired command.
Supplies the reflexive act of placing oneself in protection as the command's guarded posture.
Makes the resulting arrangement beneficial and salutary for its human recipients.

changed_reading.before: A generic instruction to worship and fear God.
changed_reading.after: A coupled program of exclusive allegiance and self-protection presented as the addressees' own good.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The voiced saying at word 3 is directed to a named people at word 4 before the worship imperative at word 5.
baseline_models.mechanism: An uttered declaration enters a concrete collective and asks that collective to redirect its shared obedience; the scene is public realignment rather than private counsel.

activation_trace.role: Makes the intervention an externally voiced and socially audible saying.
Locates the addressees as Abraham's associated human collective.
Identifies humbled obedience as the shared orientation being redirected.

changed_reading.before: Abraham gives individuals a devotional instruction.
changed_reading.after: Abraham publicly bids his people to reorganize their collective allegiance.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The comparative at word 9 is followed by the conditional knowing construction at words 11-13.
baseline_models.mechanism: The benefit is asserted, but its uptake is conditioned on disclosure to the addressees; superiority is real in the saying yet must become recognizable to them.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the beneficial side of the comparison rather than an unqualified command alone.
Makes apprehension of that benefit the explicit epistemic threshold.

changed_reading.before: The commands are simply declared better.
changed_reading.after: Their superiority is posed as a truth whose force depends on the hearers actually recognizing it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah first places verbal professions in an assay and later lets Abraham's voiced summons draw a threat of burning followed by rescue. His saying therefore functions as an event that exposes the quality of allegiance under pressure.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in Abraham's publicly emitted words.
Contributes the assay of a person or material as the surah's frame for disclosed allegiance.
Materializes the pressure on Abraham's declaration as an explicit fire threat.
Completes the assay by separation and deliverance from the threatened destruction.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 place spoken belief under testing that differentiates truthful from false allegiance.
29:24 records the people's answer to Abraham as killing or burning and then records God's rescue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the assay frame and the later threat-rescue sequence; I infer that Abraham's speech initiates a disclosure event. A live alternative is that the testing frame describes believers generally and only parallels, rather than governs, his scene.

changed_reading.before: Abraham's saying communicates a correct proposition to his people.
changed_reading.after: His saying places communal allegiance into an assay whose coercive response reveals what each side serves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate continuation denies the worshiped objects any ownership of provision, then links seeking from God, worship, gratitude, and return. The focus command reallocates dependence as well as ritual attention.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the changed reading in the focus command's humbled obedience.
Allows the redirection of dependence to specify the practical good asserted in the focus.
Supplies the denied capacity to own and dispose of what the people need.
Supplies allotted provision as the concrete object whose true source reorganizes allegiance.
Turns recognition of the true source into an active search directed toward God.
Makes gratitude to the benefactor the answering motion after provision and worship.
Closes the dependency circuit with return to the one from whom provision is sought.
Reinforces provision as sustaining food that creatures need not themselves carry because God supplies it.

structural_cues: 29:17 is the immediate explanation after the focus and coordinates provision-seeking, worship, gratitude, and return.
29:60-62 repeat that creatures do not carry their provision and that God apportions it expansively or narrowly.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lack of ownership, provision, directed seeking, gratitude, and return; I infer that attributed livelihood creates or redirects allegiance. A live alternative is that provision is only an argument for cultic worship, not a description of economic dependence itself.

changed_reading.before: Worship God because that devotion is religiously better.
changed_reading.after: Transfer practical dependence from provisionless cultic objects to God, and answer received provision with worship and gratitude before the return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The people have adopted idols as a bond of affection among themselves, but that bond reverses into mutual repudiation and expulsion. Abraham's address to his people competes with an idol-mediated social architecture, seeking a community whose cohesion can survive accountability.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the concrete collective Abraham addresses.
Makes shared obedience the axis on which that collective can be reorganized.
Contributes deliberate adoption and acquisition to the making of the people's cultic arrangement.
Identifies affection as the present social payoff binding the idol-users.
Locates that affection as a connective relation running between members.
Reverses the connective bond into hostile distancing under final accountability.

structural_cues: 29:24 shows the addressed people enforcing their order through a kill-or-burn response.
29:25 names present affection between idol-users and its future reversal into mutual denial and cursing.
29:36 repeats the people-address plus worship command while joining it to public non-corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet explicitly supplies idol adoption, inter-personal affection, and later reversal; I infer that cult sustains group cohesion and that Abraham proposes a rival basis of belonging. A live alternative is that affection is merely the motive for idol use, not a full social structure.

changed_reading.before: Abraham tells an already constituted people to change its object of worship.
changed_reading.after: He asks a people held together by cultic affection to become a differently constituted community before that affection turns against them.

context_deltas.mechanism: No alternate patron can defeat accountability, and taking such patrons is compared to inhabiting the weakest house. The focus pairing of guarding oneself and knowing becomes discernment about protective architecture: one cannot evade God through substitutes, so protection concerning God requires exclusive alignment rather than a rival shelter.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in putting oneself into a guarded posture concerning God.
Anchors the focus claim that the protective good must be recognized.
Supplies the denied possibility of an alternate loving and helping patron outside God.
Frames substitute protectors as agents entrusted with care that cannot actually hold.
Supplies the web-making creature for the surah's material analogy of false protection.
Makes refuge and dwelling the concrete form in which claimed protection is evaluated.
Diagnoses the substitute shelter as structurally weak and unable to sustain reliance.
Echoes the focus condition of knowing at the point where false shelter is exposed.

structural_cues: 29:21-22 combine mercy and punishment with inability to escape or find another patron or helper.
29:41 repeats the knowledge condition while evaluating substitute patrons through the spider-house comparison.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies inescapability, absent substitute patronage, fragile shelter, and the repeated knowledge condition; I infer that these specify the protective logic of the focus command. A live alternative is that the focus verb means guarded fear of judgment without any shelter analogy.

changed_reading.before: Guard yourselves through a general attitude of fear toward God.
changed_reading.after: Recognize that no substitute shelter can screen you from God, and take up the accountable alignment that alone makes guarding meaningful.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the people answer coercively, Abraham departs toward his Lord; later, the breadth of God's earth grounds a renewed worship imperative. Allegiance is therefore portable across territory and may require leaving the social space named in the focus.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the starting location in Abraham's inherited human collective.
Anchors the portable constant in obedient worship rather than place or kin.
Contributes movement from one abode to another as Abraham's response after rejection.
Supplies terrestrial space as the field across which worship can continue.
Opens that field beyond the constriction of a hostile local order.
Repeats servanthood and worship as the allegiance maintained across the opened terrain.

structural_cues: 29:24 gives the people's coercive answer, and 29:26 gives Abraham's migration toward his Lord.
29:56 grounds an exclusive worship command in the breadth of God's earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies rejection, Abraham's change of abode, broad earth, and renewed worship; I infer that spatial release enables fidelity to the focus command. A live alternative is that migration is only a later consequence and does not retroactively color the initial summons.

changed_reading.before: The command asks Abraham's people to reform while remaining within their inherited social place.
changed_reading.after: The allegiance offered to the people is not place-bound; when their order becomes coercive, it can be carried beyond them across God's broad earth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly turns rescues, remnants, creation, and parables into visible marks to be seen, inspected, restrained in mind, and known. The focus condition is thus not passive information but competence in reading traces that demonstrate why the paired commands are better.

activation_trace.role: Anchors knowing in the branch of a distinguishing mark that directs a perceiver.
Makes Noah's deliverance a manifest mark available to later readers.
Requires sight or insight to notice how creation begins.
Turns travel into directed observation for apprehending the creative process.
Makes reasoning a restraint against missing the clear remnant left for a people.
Associates successful uptake of the surah's comparisons with those who genuinely know.

structural_cues: 29:15, 29:24, and 29:35 leave historical deliverance or destruction as signs.
29:19-20 move from seeing to travel and directed observation of creation.
29:41-43 place the spider comparison between a knowledge conditional and the claim that knowers grasp parables.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sustained sequence of marks, seeing, observing, reasoning, and knowing; I infer that the focus conditional names this evidential practice. A live alternative is that it is a conventional admonitory conditional with no special method of knowing implied.

changed_reading.before: If the hearers possess the relevant fact, they will agree that worship and guarding are better.
changed_reading.after: If they can read the historical, material, and created traces around them, they can verify the superiority claimed for worship and guarded allegiance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing contrast repeats the knowledge condition while demoting near life to diversion and aimless play and identifying the later abode with actual living. The focus comparative is recalibrated by durability and ultimate return rather than immediate social convenience.

activation_trace.role: Anchors the model in the claim of a beneficial alternative for the people.
Spans the two mentions of life and sharpens the claim that only one is fully living.
Marks the present life as the near or lower horizon against which benefit can be mismeasured.
Contributes displacement from what matters by absorption in something else.
Contributes action lacking a sound final purpose to the diagnosis of near-life priorities.
Supplies the later horizon in which the focus claim's comparative value is finally measured.
Repeats the focus's knowing condition precisely where the two scales of life are contrasted.

structural_cues: 29:25 locates idol-mediated affection in near life and shows it reversing on the day of rising.
29:57 places death before return, while 29:64 contrasts near life with the later abode and repeats the conditional of knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated knowledge formula and an explicit contrast between near-life distraction and later-life reality; I infer that this contrast sets the scale for the focus word 'better.' A live alternative is that the focus comparison also includes immediate worldly welfare, especially provision and social order.

changed_reading.before: The commands are better by an unspecified measure of benefit.
changed_reading.after: They are better on the scale of durable life and return, even when idol-based cohesion appears more useful in the near term.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later prayer is a specified worship practice whose stated action is to restrain conspicuous indecency and repudiated wrong. The focus pairing of worship and guarding becomes operational: repeated devotion forms an internal brake against boundary-crossing conduct.

activation_trace.role: Anchors prayer within the broader field of obedient and humbled worship.
Supplies the barrier logic that the later restraining practice makes concrete.
Contributes the specified ritual practice as a repeatable form of worship.
Contributes prayer as a binding devotional practice rather than a momentary assent.
Supplies the explicit checking and restraining action attributed to prayer.
Names conspicuously ugly conduct as one object against which the restraint works.
Names repudiated wrong as the second object checked by the practice.

structural_cues: 29:45 explicitly states that prayer restrains indecency and repudiated wrong.
29:28-30 and 29:36 place prophetic worship calls alongside communal violations and corruption.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet itself supplies prayer's restraining arrow; I infer that this specified practice exemplifies how the focus's worship command generates the guarding paired with it. A live alternative is that the two focus imperatives remain coordinate duties rather than cause and effect.

changed_reading.before: Worship and guarding are adjacent obligations.
changed_reading.after: Worship can be the repeated discipline through which guarding becomes behaviorally effective against transgression.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the road branch of the focus root is materially distant from the imperative's ordinary devotional sense. It remains anchored in focus word 5 and becomes coherent through the surah's repeated offered, cut, blocked, and divinely guided paths. Downstream prose must present it only as a material analogy for formation, never as a replacement translation of the imperative.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 5 permits an exploratory root-branch resonance with a road made level and traversable.

activation_trace.role: Supplies the material image of preparing and smoothing a route as an analogy for worshipful formation.
Introduces a traversable path claimed by disbelievers and offered for others to follow.
Shows a traversable route being severed by corrupt communal practice.
Supplies active diversion away from the path despite the people's apparent perception.
Keeps the blocked object concrete as a way meant to be traveled.
Supplies gentle direction toward the true road as the answer to striving.
Ends the surah with multiple traversable divine paths opened to the strivers.

changed_reading.before: Worship is a cultic act commanded at one point in the narrative.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, worship is roadwork on the self and community: making divine paths traversable where false guides offer, cut, or block routes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates standing and resurrection branches behind the ordinary collective noun in the focus. The shared root and the surah's repeated day-of-rising occurrences keep the resonance anchored, but downstream prose must mark it as root-internal wordplay, not translate 'people' as 'resurrection' or claim semantic identity.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 4 names Abraham's people while its root inventory also carries rising to an affair and the final rising.

activation_trace.role: Keeps the primary anchor in the actual human collective addressed by Abraham.
Adds the exploratory resonance of resolving upon and rising into an affair.
Places carried burdens before the day when the collective must rise for accounting.
Places the reversal of idol-based affection at that same final rising.

changed_reading.before: Abraham addresses an ethnic or social collective as it presently exists.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root resonance, he summons that people to stand now in worship before the final standing exposes and reorders its bonds.

strongest_changes: The paired commands became a transfer of dependence from provisionless cultic objects to God as giver, with seeking, gratitude, and return completing the circuit.
The addressed people emerged as a social formation held together by idol-mediated affection that can become coercive now and reverse under accountability.
Guarding and knowing were concretized by absent substitute patrons and the spider-house comparison as discernment about protection that can actually hold.
The repeated knowledge condition recalibrated what is 'better' by trace-reading and by the horizon of durable life rather than near-term convenience.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah reconstruction linked the focus's compact sequence of saying, people, worship, guarding, good, and knowing to unusually concrete mechanisms: assay by fire, provision circuits, social bonding, fragile shelter, migration, disciplined restraint, visible signs, and path formation.
remaining_uncertainties: The shelter model is analogical: the focus command concerns guarding oneself with respect to God and does not itself state that God is a shelter.
Migration may be only a consequence of the people's rejection rather than part of the initial command's semantics.
The roadmaking and people-standing readings are deliberately contained root resonances, not lexical translations.
The focus comparative may include immediate worldly benefit as well as the later-life scale emphasized by the surah's close.
